items.title: Centre clears appointments of Justice AY Kogje as Chief Justice of Madhya Pradesh High Court
items.summary: The Central government has cleared appointment of Gujarat High Court judge Justice Alpesh Yeshvant Kogje as the Chief Justice of the Madhya Pradesh High Court. The appointment was announced on X by Union Minister of State for Law Arjun Ram Meghwal on Saturday night. Justice Kogje was recommended by the Supreme Court Collegium after its meeting held on August 31. Justice Kogje is presently serving as a judge of the Gujarat High Court. Justice Kogje completed his B.Sc. in Chemistry in 1990 and earned his law degree from the Faculty of Law at Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda in 1993. He joined the Bar in 1993. Throughout his career as counsel, he held several significant roles, including Additional Public Prosecutor from 2002 to 2007, Standing Counsel for the Central Excise and Customs Department, and Special Public Prosecutor for the Special Investigation Team (SIT), where he notably handled a large volume of important cases arising from the 2002 Godhra riots. He was elevated as an additional judge of the Gujarat High Court in April 2016. He was subsequently appointed as a permanent judge of the Gujarat High Court in March 2018. items.title: ED searches premises linked to Karnataka minister Satish Jarkiholi, daughter
items.summary: The Enforcement Directorate (ED), on Wednesday, September 9, conducted searches at multiple premises linked to Karnataka Public Works Department Minister Satish Jarkiholi, his daughter and Chikkodi Lok Sabha MP Priyanka Jarkiholi, and others as part of an investigation into alleged irregularities in the issuance of bar licences. According to multiple reports, around 18 premises are being searched, including the 64-year-old minister’s residence in Bengaluru’s Dollars Colony and premises linked to his daughter. The searches are being carried out at more than 15 locations across Karnataka and Maharashtra, including residences, family-linked properties, businesses and premises associated with the Jarkiholi family. The searches cover multiple locations in Bengaluru, as well as Belagavi and Gokak, while premises linked to people associated with the minister are also under scrutiny. There was no immediate clarity on whether Satish Jarkiholi was present at any of the locations being searched. The ED action is linked to a probe into alleged irregularities surrounding the issuance of 18 bar licences. items.title: CCI closes WinZO antitrust case against Google after online gaming ban
items.summary: The Competition Commission of India (CCI) has closed its antitrust probe against Google over its treatment of real-money gaming apps, citing the subsequent statutory ban on online money games. The regulator cited the subsequent statutory ban on online money games in view of which it decided to close the matter. The CCI recalled its November 2024 order directing a probe into allegations that Google discriminated between different categories of real-money gaming apps on the Play Store and Google Ads. However, the CCI clarified that the closure does not amount to any finding on the merits of the alleged anti-competitive conduct. The case arose from a complaint filed by WinZO Games Private Limited against Google LLC, Alphabet Inc and Google’s Indian entities. WinZO alleged abuse of dominance under Section 4 of the Competition Act, 2002. WinZO challenged Google’s 2022 pilot programme that permitted only Daily Fantasy Sports (DFS) and Rummy real-money gaming apps on the Play Store while excluding other RMG applications. It also objected to Google’s advertising policy allowing advertisements for DFS and Rummy apps, and to warnings displayed when users attempted certain payments through Go

items.title: Sikkim district judge moves Supreme Court against High Court, alleges vindictive vigilance action
items.summary: A sitting district judge in Sikkim has approached the Supreme Court against the Sikkim High Court, alleging that he has been subjected to a sustained campaign of harassment and retaliatory vigilance action after he complained against a then sitting judge of the High Court, who is now retired. District and Sessions Judge at Mangan, Prajwal Khatiwada , has filed a writ petition under Article 32 challenging a show cause notice issued to him by the High Court of Sikkim on August 12. The petition names the High Court of Sikkim, its Registrar (Vigilance), Vigilance Inspector Sarad Subba and the State of Sikkim as respondents. Khatiwada joined the Sikkim Judicial Service in 2005 after topping the State's judicial service examination. He served as Registrar General of the High Court from February 2023 to December 2025 before being posted to Mangan. According to the petition, the trouble started after Khatiwada lodged a formal complaint on December 12, 2025 against a then sitting judge of the High Court, alleging mistreatment and humiliation. items.title: Fox Mandal & Associates advises on Brigade Enterprises’ entry into Coimbatore
items.summary: Brigade Enterprises Limited has entered into a Joint Development Agreement for its first residential project in Coimbatore. Fox Mandal & Associates advised Brigade Enterprises on the transaction, carrying out due diligence and drafting of transaction documents including definitive Joint Development Agreement. The transaction was led by Jayaprakash Padmanaban (Senior Partner), supported by Lakshmi Kandasubramanian (Senior Associate) and Maria Jansi Rani (Associate). The project spans a 5.43-acre land parcel in Saravanampatti, within Coimbatore’s IT corridor, and carries an estimated Gross Development Value (GDV) of approximately ₹600 crore.
